scope: Frosty global compute 219 through Xbox device slot 62. Same-fixture comparison with packaged ray-generation entry 218 and analytic solid-triangle shadows. Each case checks 64 pixels, all four mask words, the pre-resolved first pixel and 28 guard words.
guest_scene: Xbox List4 slot 117 builds triangle BLAS and two-instance TLAS. Raw t5 in the original SRV table names the TLAS resource. The guest binds only its four original root descriptor tables.
dispatch: 8 by 1 by 1 groups, 8 by 4 by 1 threads. Queue length zero or one. Instance masks 0x20 at x=-1 and 0x01 at x=3.
limits: Controlled triangle scenes. Native Xbox BVH traversal order, iteration exhaustion, procedural primitives and in-game output remain unverified.

engine_root_controls.version_1_0: Reordered SRV table at root slot 2, t5 at table offset 7 via APPEND, UAV at root slot 0 and b0 through b2 as root CBVs; all six shadow cases passed on each adapter.
engine_root_controls.volatile_scene: Replacing t5 with another valid TLAS after command-list Close rejected the batch before submission. Signal returned E_INVALIDARG and the fence stayed at zero. A changed scene requires re-recording the list.
